source: Tip: CTRL + mouse wheel = fly faster or slower
translation: 提示：CTRL + 鼠标滚轮可加速或减速飞行

source: Tip: mouse wheel = fly faster or slower  ·  CTRL + wheel = zoom
translation: 提示：鼠标滚轮可加速或减速飞行 · CTRL + 滚轮可缩放

source: Look around, fly and change your speed in the 3D view.
translation: 在三维视图中环顾、飞行并调整速度。

source: Hold the right mouse button and move the mouse to look around.
translation: 按住鼠标右键，移动鼠标环顾四周。

source: Keep holding it and fly with W, A, S and D.
translation: 继续按住右键，用 W、A、S、D 飞行。

source: Press {Hoch} to fly up and {Runter} to fly down.
translation: 按 {Hoch} 上升，按 {Runter} 下降。

source: Roll the mouse wheel to fly faster or slower.
translation: 滚动鼠标滚轮，调整飞行速度。

source: Hold the middle mouse button to slide the view sideways.
translation: 按住鼠标中键，平移视角。

source: CTRL + mouse wheel zooms in and out.
translation: CTRL + 鼠标滚轮可缩放视图。

source: TAB switches between the 2D plan and the 3D view.
translation: 按 TAB 切换二维平面图和三维视图。

source: Draw a room, move walls, change their length and erase them.
translation: 绘制房间、移动墙体、调整长度或删除墙体。

source: Press {PlanWand} to take the wall tool.
Click from corner to corner. Click your first corner again to close the room.
translation: 依次点击各个墙角。再次点击起点，闭合房间。

source: Press ESC to put the tool away, then drag one of your walls to move it.
translation: 按 ESC 收起工具，再拖动墙体以移动。

source: Click a wall and type a new length in the panel on the left.
translation: 点击墙体，在左侧面板输入新的长度。

source: Press {PlanRadierer} for the eraser and click a wall to remove it.
translation: 按 {PlanRadierer} 选择橡皮擦，点击墙体将其删除。

source: Press CTRL + Z to bring the wall back.
translation: 按 CTRL + Z 恢复墙体。

source: A right click stops a wall chain.
translation: 点击右键停止连续绘墙。

source: While drawing, type a length and press ENTER for an exact wall.
translation: 绘制时输入长度并按 ENTER，可精确设置墙长。

source: CTRL + A selects the whole building - drag it to move everything.
translation: CTRL + A 选中整栋建筑，拖动即可整体移动。

source: Place windows and doors and change their size.
Press {PlanFenster} and click a wall to place a window.
Press ESC, click your window and change its width in the panel on the left.
translation: 按 ESC，点击窗户，在左侧面板调整宽度。

source: Press {PlanTuer} and click a wall to place a door.
Press TAB to see your room in 3D.
translation: 按 TAB 在三维视图中查看房间。

source: Drag a window along its wall to move it.
translation: 沿墙拖动窗户，即可移动窗户。

source: The panel has more types: sliding and folding doors, tilt and turn windows.
translation: 面板中还有更多类型：推拉门、折叠门、内开内倒窗。

source: In First Person, click a door to open it.
translation: 在第一人称模式下，点击门即可打开。

source: Place, select, move and delete objects from the library.
translation: 放置、选择、移动和删除资源库中的物件。

source: Press {Werkzeug1} to open the library and click any piece of furniture.
translation: 按 {Werkzeug1} 打开资源库，点击任意家具。

source: Roll the mouse wheel to turn it, then left click to place it.
translation: 滚动鼠标滚轮旋转家具，点击左键放置。

source: Press ESC, then click your furniture to select it.
translation: 按 ESC，再点击家具将其选中。

source: Click the move icon above it, then click a new spot.
translation: 点击家具上方的移动图标，再点击新位置。

source: Select a piece of furniture and press DEL to remove it.
translation: 选中家具后按 DEL，将其删除。

source: The copy icon above an object places a copy right away.
translation: 点击物件上方的复制图标，可立即放置副本。

source: Type in the search field of the library to find things fast.
translation: 在资源库搜索框中输入文字，快速查找物件。

source: Size, colour and material of the selected object are in the panel on the left.
translation: 左侧面板可调整所选物件的尺寸、颜色和材质。

source: Paint surfaces, copy materials and change colours.
translation: 涂刷表面、复制材质和调整颜色。

source: Press {Werkzeug2}, pick a material and click a piece of furniture.
translation: 按 {Werkzeug2}，选择材质并点击家具。

source: Now click a wall to paint it with the same material.
translation: 再点击墙体，将同一材质涂到墙上。

source: Right click to put the material away.
translation: 点击右键收起材质工具。

source: Hold ALT and click something to pick up its material.
translation: 按住 ALT 并点击物件，吸取其材质。

source: Click another surface to paste that material onto it.
translation: 点击另一表面，将该材质应用到上面。

source: Press ESC, select a piece of furniture and change its colour with the colour wheel on the left.
translation: 按 ESC，选中家具，用左侧色轮调整颜色。

source: Texture scale and rotation sit right next to the colour wheel.
translation: 纹理缩放和旋转控件就在色轮旁边。

source: Add your own photos as materials under My Materials.
translation: 在“我的材质”中添加自己的照片作为材质。

source: Select several objects and move, rotate or scale them exactly.
translation: 选择多个物件，并精确移动、旋转或缩放。

source: Hold SHIFT and click two pieces of furniture.
translation: 按住 SHIFT，点击两件家具。

source: Press SPACE for the gizmo and drag an arrow to move them.
translation: 按 SPACE 显示操纵器，拖动箭头移动物件。

source: Press SPACE again and drag a ring to rotate.
translation: 再次按 SPACE，拖动圆环旋转物件。

source: Press SPACE once more and drag a handle to scale.
translation: 再按一次 SPACE，拖动手柄缩放物件。

source: Press CTRL + Z to undo the last change.
translation: 按 CTRL + Z 撤销上一步修改。

source: Drag over empty ground to select with a box.
translation: 在空地上拖动，框选物件。

source: GRID on the right snaps moves to a grid.
translation: 右侧的“网格”让移动吸附到网格。

source: CTRL + C and CTRL + V copy your selection.
translation: CTRL + C 和 CTRL + V 可复制所选物件。

source: Add floors, place stairs and cut floor openings.
translation: 添加楼层、放置楼梯，并开设楼板洞口。

source: In the Storey tower on the right, click the arrow with the plus at the top to add a floor.
translation: 在右侧楼层栏中，点击顶部带加号的箭头添加楼层。

source: Click the lower number in the tower to edit the ground floor again.
translation: 点击楼层栏中下方的数字，返回底层编辑。

source: Press {PlanTreppe} and click inside your room to place stairs.
translation: 按 {PlanTreppe}，在房间内点击放置楼梯。

source: Press {PlanDurchbruch} and click two corners for an opening in the floor.
translation: 按 {PlanDurchbruch}，点击两个角点开设楼板洞口。

source: R turns the stairs while you place them.
translation: 放置楼梯时按 R 旋转。

source: The stair panel switches between straight, L and U shape.
translation: 楼梯面板可切换直跑、L 形和 U 形楼梯。

source: One stair can reach over several floors.
translation: 一部楼梯可以跨越多个楼层。

source: N adds a floor too; Page Up / Page Down switch floors.
translation: 按 N 也可添加楼层；Page Up / Page Down 切换楼层。

source: Draw a roof over your room and change its shape.
translation: 在房间上方绘制屋顶并调整形状。

source: Click the corners of your room one by one, then click the first corner again.
translation: 依次点击房间各个角点，再次点击起点完成。

source: Press ESC, click your roof and pick another roof type on the left.
translation: 按 ESC，点击屋顶，在左侧选择其他屋顶类型。

source: Press DEL to remove the roof again.

translation: 屋顶开口可用于制作老虎窗。

source: Roof windows go right into the roof.
Tiles or Rows change the roof covering.
translation: 调整“瓦片”或“分排铺设”可改变屋面铺装。

source: Draw a kitchen along a wall and set up its cabinets.
translation: 沿墙绘制厨房并配置橱柜。

source: Click where the kitchen starts and where it ends along a wall, then right click.
translation: 沿墙点击厨房的起点和终点，再点击右键完成。

source: Press ESC and click a cabinet to select it.
translation: 按 ESC，点击橱柜将其选中。

source: Each cabinet can be drawers, doors, an oven or a sink.
translation: 每个橱柜都可设为抽屉、柜门、烤箱或水槽。

source: The 2D plan shows the width of every cabinet.
translation: 二维平面图会显示每个橱柜的宽度。

source: Around a corner, a corner cabinet appears by itself.
translation: 转角处会自动生成转角柜。

source: Add railings, fences and garden paths.
translation: 添加栏杆、围栏和花园小径。

source: Press {Werkzeug5}, click points for a railing and right click to finish.
translation: 按 {Werkzeug5}，点击栏杆各点，右键结束。

source: Press {PlanWeg} in the 2D plan and click two corners for a path.
translation: 在二维平面图按 {PlanWeg}，点击两个角点绘制路径。

source: Drag the points of a railing to change it later.
translation: 以后可拖动栏杆的节点来修改。

source: Give a path a height to make a terrace.
translation: 给路径设置高度，即可建造露台。

source: Raise, smooth and paint the ground and stamp exact shapes.
translation: 抬高、平滑或涂刷地形，并压印精确形状。

source: Pick Raise (the first icon in the panel) and hold the left mouse button on the ground.
translation: 选择“抬高”（面板第一个图标），在地面上按住左键。

source: Pick Smooth (the third icon) and paint over your hill.
translation: 选择“平滑”（第三个图标），涂刷刚建的山丘。

source: Click a material like Sand at the bottom of the panel and paint it onto the ground.
translation: 点击面板底部的沙地等材质，将其涂到地面上。

source: Pick Stamp (the last icon) and click the ground to place a box.
translation: 选择“压印”（最后一个图标），点击地面放置方框。

source: Choose Raise or Lower, drag its arrows or type the size, then click Build Stamp.
translation: 选择抬高或降低，拖动箭头或输入尺寸，再点击“生成压印”。

source: Ramp works the same way: set the high and low end, then Build Ramp.
translation: 坡道操作相同：设置高低两端，再点击“生成坡道”。

source: Gravel, Sand and Stone have a Tile size slider for a finer or coarser look.
translation: 砾石、沙地和石地的纹理尺寸滑块可调整纹理粗细。

source: Stamp with Lower digs an exact pit - perfect for a pool.
translation: 用“降低”压印可挖出精确坑洞，很适合建造泳池。

source: Level flattens the ground to the height where you start.
translation: “整平”会将地面调整到开始操作处的高度。

source: A right click puts the brush down and frees the mouse.
translation: 点击右键放下画笔，释放鼠标。

source: Fill an area with plants or turn it into water.
translation: 用植物填满区域，或将区域变成水面。

source: Click points around an area on the ground, then right click to finish.
translation: 沿地面区域点击各个边界点，再点击右键完成。

source: Drag one of its points to change the area.
translation: 拖动任意节点即可改变区域形状。

source: Pick Pond in the panel to turn the area into water.
translation: 在面板中选择“池塘”，将区域变成水面。

source: CTRL + click on the line adds a point, ALT + click removes one.
translation: CTRL + 点击线段添加节点，ALT + 点击删除节点。

source: Build your own objects and edit them like in a 3D program.
translation: 创建自己的物件，像三维软件一样进行编辑。

source: Press {Werkzeug3}, pick the box and click the ground to place it.
translation: 按 {Werkzeug3}，选择方块并点击地面放置。

source: Press ESC, click your box and drag one of its arrows to resize it.
translation: 按 ESC，点击方块，拖动箭头调整尺寸。

source: Click Start next to Edit shape in the panel on the left.
translation: 点击左侧面板“编辑形状”旁的“开始”。

source: Click a face of the box and drag the yellow arrow to pull it out.
translation: 点击方块的一个面，拖动黄色箭头将其拉出。

source: Click Smooth in the panel to round the edges.
translation: 点击面板中的“平滑”，将边缘变圆滑。

source: Vertex, Edge and Face choose what a click picks.
translation: “顶点”“边”和“面”决定点击时选取的元素。

source: See-through lets you pick hidden parts too.
translation: “穿透选择”也能选中隐藏的部分。

source: Save shape to library keeps it for later.
translation: 将形状保存到资源库，以便日后使用。

source: Walk through your house and switch lights and doors.
translation: 漫步自己的房屋，开关灯具和门。

source: Click First Person at the top left.
translation: 点击左上角的“第一人称”。

source: Walk around with W, A, S and D.
Aim at the lamp or the door and click to switch it.
translation: 瞄准灯具或门，点击即可开关。

source: SHIFT switches between walking and building.
translation: 按 SHIFT 切换行走和建造模式。

source: {Stirnlampe} turns your headlamp on and off.
Stairs and floor openings can be walked through.
translation: 可以通过楼梯和楼板洞口上下楼。

source: Save your project and export your floor plan as a PDF.
translation: 保存项目，并将平面图导出为 PDF。

source: Click the three dots at the top right to open the options.
translation: 点击右上角的三个点打开选项。

source: In the Project tab, click Save and pick a slot.
translation: 在“项目”页点击“保存”，并选择存档位。

source: Open the Share tab and click PDF.
Quick save stores your project in the same slot again.
translation: 快速保存会将项目再次存入同一存档位。

source: Share puts your house on the Steam Workshop.
translation: “分享”会将房屋上传到 Steam 创意工坊。

source: The PDF is a real floor plan with all dimensions.
translation: PDF 是带完整尺寸标注的正式平面图。

source: Start here - everything you need for your first house
translation: 从这里开始：建造第一栋房屋所需的一切

source: Bigger parts: floors, roofs, kitchen and more
translation: 大型构件：楼层、屋顶、厨房等

source: Your garden and the land around the house
translation: 花园和房屋周围的地形

source: For when you want to go further
translation: 想进一步探索时，看看这里

source: Loading an outdoor world for this topic...
translation: 正在为本主题加载户外场景……

source: Short topics, about a minute each. Start with the basics or jump straight to what you need - you can leave at any time and your progress is kept.
translation: 每个主题约一分钟。从基础入门，或直接选择需要的内容。随时可退出，进度会保留。

source: All %d topics done - you know everything to build your dream house!
translation: 已完成全部 %d 个主题！现在你能建造梦想之家了！

source: Not quite working? Click Skip - you can come back to this topic any time.
translation: 操作不顺利？点击“跳过”，以后随时可以回来继续。

translation: 此步骤需在%s中操作，请在左上角切换。
已忽略 %d 条家具块线段。

translation: 检测到填充墙体，已忽略其他 %d 对平行线。

source: %d door swings rebuilt from line chains.
translation: 已从连续线段重建 %d 处门扇开启弧线。

translation: 已忽略 %d 组独立线段（图签、图例）。
已忽略 %d 处零散小线段。

source: %d window/door sizes read from labels (head height %.2f m).
translation: 从标注读取 %d 组门窗尺寸（顶部高度 %.2f 米）。

source: No door swings found - the drawing with the most walls was used.
translation: 未找到门扇开启弧线，已使用墙体最多的图纸。

translation: 按住鼠标左键涂刷，抬高地面

translation: 按住并涂刷，向下挖掘地面

translation: 将地面调整到开始涂刷处的高度— 适用于露台和建筑地坪

translation: 地形精确贴合坡道，保留清晰侧边；Ctrl+Z 可撤销

translation: 在下方选择材质，再将其涂到地面

translation: 修改应用于全部所选物件（Shift+点击增减选择）

source: Door height = the sliding/folding door. Above it a fixed glass light: Light height sets it, Wall strip = wall between door and light.
translation: 门高控制推拉门或折叠门高度。上方为固定亮窗：“上亮窗高度”控制其高度，“墙带”是门与亮窗之间的墙体。

source: Depth 0 = through the wall. Above 0 it becomes a niche of that depth, cut from the chosen side.
translation: 深度为 0 时贯穿墙体；大于 0 时，从所选一侧向墙内挖出相应深度的壁龛。

source: Handle side = where you pull: the panes fold to the opposite side. Center: opens in the middle, two stacks. First Person: click to fold open.
translation: 把手侧是拉动的一侧，门扇向另一侧折叠。居中：从中间打开，向两侧折叠。第一人称下点击即可折叠打开。

source: Handle side = the panel that slides. Center: the two middle panels slide apart. First Person: click to slide open.
translation: 把手侧决定滑动门扇。居中：中间两扇向两侧滑开。第一人称下点击即可推拉打开。

source: First Person: click the upper part of a sash to tilt it, lower down to open it.
translation: 第一人称下，点击窗扇上部可内倒，点击下部可平开。

source: Click where the stairs start, then where they end - they lead up to the next floor.
translation: 点击楼梯起点和终点，楼梯将通向上一层。

source: Afterwards: Length and Straight / L / U in its panel.
translation: 完成后可在面板中调整长度及直跑 / L / U 形。

source: Click a start and an end point for a straight stair - click more points for L- or U-shaped stairs.
translation: 点击起点和终点绘制直跑楼梯；增加节点可绘制 L 形或 U 形楼梯。

source: Right click to finish stair. Afterwards: Length and Straight / L / U in its panel.
translation: 右键完成楼梯。之后可在面板中调整长度及直跑 / L / U 形。

source: Corner A/B: this wall's face lines up with the face of the wall it continues from — that is how a thinner wall sits flush at a corner.
translation: 角点 A/B：使当前墙面与相接墙体的墙面对齐— 让较薄的墙体在转角处也能平齐。

source: Hold Ctrl while drawing: no snapping (grid, corners, guides). Shift: half grid.
translation: 绘制时按住 Ctrl：关闭吸附（网格、角点和辅助线）。Shift：半格吸附。

source: Invisible walls divide rooms (own floor per room) and carry roofs, but are not built: no wall, no collision.
translation: 隐形墙用于划分房间（各自拥有地板）并支撑屋顶，但不会生成实体墙或碰撞。

source: Two corners make a room: four walls, closed. Floor and ceiling come by themselves.
translation: 两个角点即可生成四面闭合墙体，地板和天花板会自动生成。

source: Click corner after corner. Back at the first corner, the room is closed.
translation: 依次点击各个墙角，回到第一个角点即可闭合房间。

source: Click: set a corner  ·  Right-click: finish the chain
translation: 点击：设置墙角·  右键：结束连续绘制

source: Esc: finish the chain, again: leave building  ·  click the last corner again to finish
translation: Esc：结束连续绘制，再按退出建造·  再次点击最后一个角点即可结束

source: Exact length: while drawing, type it (e.g. 4.5) and press Enter
translation: 精确长度：绘制时输入数值（如 4.5），再按 Enter

source: Niche: cut into the wall from the room side (switch to Outside after placing). Give it its own material in the panel.
translation: 壁龛：从房间内侧向墙内开凿（放置后可切换到外侧）。可在面板中单独设置材质。

source: Click on a wall to place the window
Click on a wall to place the door
This flight belongs to a stair from a floor below. Change it there - width, steps, shape and Floors.
translation: 此梯段属于下层楼梯。请在下层调整宽度、踏步、形状和跨越楼层。

source: Move it with the gizmo arrows (Ctrl = 10 cm grid)
translation: 用操纵器箭头移动（Ctrl = 10 cm 网格）

source: Moving or lifting the selection with the gizmo moves or lifts the whole house with it. Ctrl+A selects all furniture.
translation: 用操纵器移动或抬高所选物件时，整栋房屋会同步移动或抬高。Ctrl+A 选择全部家具。

source: Lines up the selected objects (X/Y = the axes of the house). Even spacing needs 3 or more; the outer two stay.
translation: 对齐所选物件（X/Y 为房屋坐标轴）。等间距分布至少需要 3 个物件，最外侧两个保持不动。

source: Click to set points (Shift: 15° steps). Click the first point, Enter or right-click to finish. Backspace: undo point, Esc: cancel. The shape gets the thickness set above.
translation: 点击设置节点（Shift：15°吸附）。点击起点、按 Enter 或右键完成。Backspace：撤销节点；Esc：取消。形状使用上方设置的厚度。

source: Click a house wall to grow ivy there. Size, density and leaf colour follow in the panel.
translation: 点击房屋墙面生成常春藤。随后可在面板调整尺寸、密度和叶片颜色。

source: Click: place  ·  Mouse wheel: rotate  ·  Right-click: done
translation: 点击：放置·  滚轮：旋转·  右键：完成

source: Click 1: a wall corner (sets storey + eave)  ·  further points snap free at that height, locking to 90° from the last point  ·  click the first point again to close and build  ·  Alt+click: delete roof  ·  overhang: click the roof afterwards
translation: 首次点击墙角，确定楼层和檐口·  后续节点在此高度自由吸附，与上一点保持 90°方向·  再次点击起点，闭合并生成屋顶·  Alt+点击：删除屋顶·  出檐：完成后点击屋顶调整

source: Click the roof surface to place the opening (Esc / right-click cancels)
translation: 点击屋面放置开口（Esc / 右键取消）

source: Click the roof surface to place the window (Esc / right-click cancels)
translation: 点击屋面放置天窗（Esc / 右键取消）

source: Click the roof surface where the dormer's front wall should stand (Esc cancels)
translation: 点击屋面，确定老虎窗前墙的位置（Esc 取消）

source: Click a dormer to change its type and size
translation: 点击老虎窗可调整类型和尺寸

source: Click a roof window to size, move or copy it
translation: 点击天窗可调整尺寸、移动或复制

source: Roof selected - arrows: overhang, and roof height on the ridge
translation: 已选择屋顶：箭头调整出檐，屋脊箭头调整屋顶高度

source: Window selected - arrows: width, height and sill
translation: 已选择窗户：箭头调整宽度、高度和窗台高度

source: Walls selected - arrows: width and wall height; drag the dormer to move it
translation: 已选择墙体：箭头调整宽度和墙高；拖动老虎窗可移动

source: Click the dormer's roof, window or walls to switch the arrows
translation: 点击老虎窗的屋顶、窗户或墙体切换箭头

source: Drag the dormer on the roof to move it (Ctrl = 10 cm grid)
translation: 在屋顶上拖动老虎窗可移动（Ctrl = 10 cm 网格）

source: Alt + drag: move a copy  ·  Del: delete
translation: Alt + 拖动：移动副本·  Del：删除

source: Drag the window on the roof to move it (Ctrl = 10 cm grid)
translation: 在屋顶上拖动天窗可移动（Ctrl = 10 cm 网格）

source: 0 = flush with the floor, higher = podium
translation: 0 = 与地板齐平，更高 = 台座

source: Click a side for its Curve slider
translation: 点击一条边，显示其曲率滑块

source: Ctrl + click a side: add a point
Follows the walls (and furniture) it is attached to
translation: 跟随其附着的墙体或家具移动

source: Click a start point, then an end point
Points snap to wall corners, wall faces and furniture (3D floor plan) - the ruler then moves with them
translation: 节点可吸附墙角、墙面和家具（三维平面图），标尺会随它们移动

source: Shift: straight  ·  Right-click / Esc: cancel the open point
translation: Shift：直线·  右键 / Esc：取消当前端点

source: Drag a corner or a side to reshape
translation: 拖动角点或边，调整形状

source: Click a point, then Del: remove it
translation: 点击节点，再按 Del 将其移除

source: Click a wall, window, door or stair to remove it - it turns red under the pointer.
translation: 点击墙体、门窗或楼梯将其删除；指针下的物件会变红。

source: Ctrl + Z brings it back  ·  Right-click or E: back to selecting
translation: Ctrl + Z 可恢复·  右键或 E：返回选择模式

source: Slope: raise or lower one side
Paint it like any surface to change the material
translation: 像涂刷其他表面一样涂刷，即可更换材质

source: Click a brush tool in the toolbar to go back to painting
translation: 点击工具栏中的笔刷工具，返回涂刷模式

source: Paint over the water to take that part away
translation: 涂刷水面以移除该部分

source: Paint the area of the pond - painting next to a pond makes it bigger
translation: 涂刷池塘区域，在池塘旁继续涂刷可扩大水面

source: Brush is down - click a tool above to pick it up. Clicks select hills now
translation: 画笔已放下，点击上方工具重新拿起。现在点击可选择山丘

source: Right click or Esc puts the brush down and frees the mouse
translation: 右键或 Esc 放下画笔，释放鼠标

source: The ground follows the box exactly, with sharp 90 degree sides - Ctrl+Z undoes it
translation: 地形精确贴合方框，保留 90 度垂直侧边；Ctrl+Z 可撤销

source: Ramp width and falloff set the shape - Add Ramp builds it in one step (Ctrl+Z undoes it)
translation: 坡道宽度和衰减决定形状；“添加坡道”一键生成（Ctrl+Z 可撤销）

source: Pick a material from the library, then paint it onto the ground
translation: 从资源库选择材质，再涂刷地面

source: Paint grass onto the ground - it grows while you paint
translation: 在地面涂刷草地，边刷边生长

source: Open the library (tab 2), pick a material, then paint
translation: 打开资源库（第 2 页），选择材质后涂刷

source: Up to 3 materials on the ground - they blend into each other
translation: 地面最多使用 3 种材质，彼此自然混合

source: Move with the gizmo · Space switches move / rotate / scale
translation: 使用操纵器移动· Space 切换移动 / 旋转 / 缩放

source: Alt + drag duplicates · Del removes · kept in your save
translation: Alt + 拖动复制· Del 删除· 随存档保存

translation: 从 DXF / DWG / PDF 生成墙体

source: Reads a CAD floor plan and builds walls, doors and windows from it. The drawing stays underneath to check.
translation: 读取 CAD 平面图并生成墙体、门和窗。原图保留在下方，便于核对。

source: Try with the ODA converter (free, 33 MB)
translation: 尝试 ODA 转换器（免费，33 MB）

source: This DWG could not be read directly (e.g. AutoCAD 2007 format). The free ODA File Converter from opendesign.com can convert it. Nothing is installed.
translation: 无法直接读取此 DWG（如 AutoCAD 2007 格式）。可使用 opendesign.com 的免费 ODA File Converter 转换，无需安装。

source: Set Scale: Draw a length in your plan that should have the same length as the set Reference
translation: 设置比例：在平面图中画一段与“参考长度”相同的线段

source: A selected wall sets the reference length
translation: 选中墙体可将其长度设为参考长度

source: Place furniture right in the plan: pick one from the library below, Space turns it, click to place. Drag to move, Del removes.
translation: 直接在平面图中放家具：从下方资源库选择，按 Space 旋转，点击放置。拖动移动，Del 删除。

source: Shape: Landscape > Pond - paint to make it bigger, Erase to take parts away
translation: 形状：景观 > 池塘；涂刷扩大区域，擦除移除部分水面

source: Click: set a point along the path  ·  Right-click or Esc: finish
translation: 点击：沿路径设置节点·  右键或 Esc：结束

source: Afterwards: footpath or cart track, width and what grows along it
translation: 完成后可调整步道或车辙、宽度和沿途植物

source: Click: set a point  ·  Right-click or Esc: finish the line
translation: 点击：设置节点·  右键或 Esc：结束曲线

source: After finishing you can switch categories and change density
translation: 完成后可切换分类并调整密度

source: Pond: draw a closed line around the area, then press "Fill water"
translation: 池塘：围绕区域绘制闭合曲线，再按“注水”

source: A pond needs at least three points
translation: 池塘至少需要三个节点

source: Ferns, nettles and forest grass grow along the path
translation: 沿路径生长蕨类、荨麻和林地草

source: Burdock, dry plants and wild grass grow along the path
translation: 沿路径生长牛蒡、干草和野草

source: Painted vegetation keeps clear of the path
translation: 已涂刷的植被会避让路径

source: Points: drag to move  ·  Alt+click deletes  ·  Ctrl+click on the line adds one
translation: 节点：拖动移动·  Alt+点击删除·  Ctrl+点击线段添加节点

source: Wind and bugs apply to the whole garden
translation: 风和昆虫设置应用于整个花园

source: Click a category — spacing, size and randomness apply to it alone
translation: 点击一个分类— 间距、尺寸和随机性仅应用于该类

source: The line is closed automatically for inside fill and water
translation: 填充内部或注水时，曲线会自动闭合

source: Round posts and round horizontal rails
Horizontal wooden boards between square posts
translation: 方形立柱之间铺设水平木板

source: Solid parapet wall with a coping on top
translation: 顶部带压顶的实体栏墙

source: Click: set a post  ·  Right-click: finish the run
translation: 点击：设置立柱·  右键：结束绘制

source: Each point keeps its own height — click along a stair and the handrail follows
translation: 每个节点保留各自高度— 沿楼梯点击，扶手便会随之起伏

source: Only in an inside corner: door on the free part, swing-out shelves inside
translation: 仅适用于内转角：外侧设柜门，内部设可旋出搁板

source: Wall unit — click the cabinet below to edit that one
translation: 吊柜 — 点击下方橱柜可编辑该橱柜

source: Shift-click picks more modules — every setting applies to all of them
translation: 按住 Shift 点击可多选模块 — 设置会应用到全部选中模块

source: Width: the neighbours give way on both sides  ·  Del deletes the run
translation: 宽度：两侧相邻模块会自动让位  ·  Del 删除整排

source: Click along the wall  ·  right-click finishes the run
translation: 沿墙点击  ·  右键完成整排

source: Modules are 60 cm wide; the last one takes what is left over
translation: 模块宽 60 厘米；最后一个模块填满剩余空间

source: Then click a module to set width, shelves, front or appliance
translation: 然后点击模块，设置宽度、搁板、门板或电器

source: First Person: click the tap or shower to turn the water on or off
translation: 第一人称：点击水龙头或淋浴即可开关水流

source: First Person: click it to switch it on or off
translation: 第一人称：点击即可开关设备

source: Put your own mp3 files into the music folder - they show up here
translation: 将自己的 MP3 文件放入音乐文件夹，即可在这里选择

source: Click on a value and type in a number
translation: 点击数值即可输入数字

source: Hold Shift to scale both sides
translation: 按住 Shift 同时缩放两侧

source: Hold Alt to drag a copy
translation: 按住 Alt 拖动可复制

source: First Person: click the fire to light it or put it out
translation: 第一人称：点击火焰即可点燃或熄灭

source: Sheer fabric: light and the view outside shine through
translation: 薄纱：透入光线，并可看到窗外

source: Switches %d light%s of '%s'. First Person: click the switch.
translation: 控制 %d 盏灯%s，属于“%s”。第一人称：点击开关。

source: %d light%s in '%s' - on/off, brightness, warmth and colour apply to all of them.
translation: %d 盏灯%s，属于“%s”——开关、亮度、色温和颜色同步应用。

source: Pick a group to switch. Group lights: select them (also several at once) and choose a group.
translation: 选择要控制的灯组。添加灯具：选中灯（可多选），再选择灯组。

source: Lights in one group share on/off, brightness, warmth and colour. A light switch can switch the group.
translation: 同一灯组共享开关、亮度、色温和颜色，可用一个开关控制整组。

source: Detail: higher = finer, thinner strands. Width adds more water, it does not stretch it
translation: 细节：数值越高，水丝越细密。增大宽度会增加水量，而非拉伸水流

source: Throw 0 = runs down the wall, higher = arcs out like a weir
translation: 抛射为 0 时沿墙流下；增大后会像溢流堰一样向外抛射

source: Calm trickles of water - place it in front of a wall or over a basin
translation: 平缓水流——放在墙前或水池上方

source: Scaling with the gizmo changes width and height too
translation: 使用操作轴缩放也会改变宽度和高度

source: She roams the house, sits down, lies down and naps when she has been still for a while
translation: 她会在屋内闲逛、坐下或躺下，静止一段时间后会小睡

source: He lives in and around the house. First Person: click him to pet him — he follows you for a while
translation: 他会在屋内外活动。第一人称：点击抚摸他 — 他会跟随你一段时间

source: Pick a material, then click this hill in 3D
translation: 选择材质，然后在三维视图中点击这座山丘

source: Raise — hold and paint to build up ground
translation: 抬高 — 按住绘制以堆高地面

source: Lower — hold and paint to dig ground away
translation: 降低 — 按住绘制以挖低地面

source: Smooth — evens out bumps and sharp edges
translation: 平滑 — 消除凸起和尖锐边缘

source: Level — pulls the ground to the height you started on
translation: 整平 — 将地面调整至起始位置的高度

source: Ramp — place a ramp, set its high and low end, then Build Ramp
translation: 坡道 — 放置坡道，设置高低端，再点击建造坡道

source: Stamp — place a box, set its size and height, then Build Stamp
translation: 印模 — 放置方框，设置尺寸和高度，再点击应用印模

source: Click the ground to place the ramp
Click the ground to place the stamp box
translation: 点击地面放置印模方框

source: Build up: the ground inside the box rises by its height
translation: 堆高：方框内的地面按设定高度升起

source: Dig out: the ground inside the box drops by its depth (pools, trenches)
translation: 挖低：方框内的地面按设定深度下降（可建水池、沟渠）

source: Drag the arrows or set the numbers. Heights are measured from the ground where you placed it.
translation: 拖动箭头或输入数值。高度以放置处的地面为基准。

source: Lower digs the box out of the ground: a flat floor at exactly this depth with straight walls.
translation: 降低：按方框挖掘地面，形成指定深度的平底与竖直侧壁。

source: Raise builds the box up from the ground: a flat top at exactly this height with straight walls.
translation: 抬高：按方框堆高地面，形成指定高度的平顶与竖直侧壁。

source: Space switches to the move / rotate gizmo. Clicking the ground moves the box there.
translation: 空格切换移动/旋转操作轴。点击地面可将方框移至该处。

source: Click the start point of the ramp
Drag a point to move it - then Add Ramp
translation: 拖动点调整位置，然后点击添加坡道

source: Smaller = finer pattern. Applies to this material everywhere on the ground.
translation: 数值越小，纹理越细密。影响地面上所有使用此材质的位置。

source: Materials: switch to 3D View (Tab) to choose and apply them.
translation: 材质：切换至三维视图（Tab）即可选择并应用。

source: Lower transparency = frosted or smoked glass. The tint colours the glass of this opening only.
translation: 透明度越低，玻璃越呈磨砂或烟色。着色仅影响此门窗的玻璃。

source: Applied to all %d walls of the house - Ctrl+Z to undo.
translation: 已应用至房屋全部 %d 面墙——Ctrl+Z 可撤销。

source: This wall does not enclose a room - nothing changed.
translation: 此墙未围成房间，未作更改。

source: Applied to %d walls of this room - Ctrl+Z to undo.
translation: 已应用至此房间的 %d 面墙——Ctrl+Z 可撤销。

source: The ceiling slopes from the knee wall height up to the ceiling, this far into the room.
translation: 天花板从矮墙高度向上倾斜至顶棚，向房间内延伸此距离。

source: Copy this wall's skirting & molding to:
translation: 将此墙的踢脚线与装饰线复制到：

source: Panels skip doors and windows. Skirting board and molding each have their own material card.
translation: 护墙板会避开门窗。踢脚线与装饰线各有独立的材质卡片。

source: Copy this material and its colour
Use the material in your hand (or the copied one) on this wall
translation: 将手中或已复制的材质应用到此墙

source: Use this look for every molding in the house
translation: 将此外观应用到房屋全部装饰线

source: Use this look for every skirting board in the house
translation: 将此外观应用到房屋全部踢脚线

source: Floor plan to convert into walls
translation: 选择要转换为墙壁的平面图

source: Downloading the DWG converter ... (this takes about a minute)
translation: 正在下载 DWG 转换器……（约需一分钟）

source: %s: %.0f %% - click higher or lower, or drag, to change the amount
translation: %s：%.0f %%——点击上方、下方或拖动可调整数量

source: Nothing selected - this category scatters nothing
translation: 未选择内容，此分类不会散布任何物体

source: Yellow = amount. Click higher or lower in a tile, or drag, to change it; bottom = off
translation: 黄色表示数量。点击格子上方、下方或拖动可调整；底部表示关闭

source: %s - click to switch on/off, click again to edit
Meadow - grass, clover, chamomile, dandelions, wild strawberries and flowers in natural patches
translation: 草甸——草、三叶草、洋甘菊、蒲公英、野草莓和花卉自然成片生长

source: Forest - poplars, young trees, ferns, nettles and dead wood
translation: 森林——杨树、幼树、蕨类、荨麻和枯木

source: Pine forest - pines in groups with clearings, saplings, ferns, branches, needles, stumps and fallen trunks
translation: 松林——松树成群分布，间有林间空地、幼树、蕨类、树枝、松针、树桩和倒木

source: Flowers - a wildflower meadow in colourful patches, with bees, bumblebees and butterflies
translation: 花卉——缤纷成片的野花草甸，伴有蜜蜂、熊蜂和蝴蝶

source: Wild plants - burdock, dry plants, nettles and a few bushes: the wild strip between field, path and forest
translation: 野生植物——牛蒡、干枯植物、荨麻和少量灌木，适合田野、道路和森林间的荒野地带

source: Field - pick the crop below and paint the field; the rows follow its shape
translation: 农田——在下方选择作物并涂画农田；作物行列会沿地块形状排列

source: Rocks - stones, gravel and dead trunks
Path - draw it as a line: click points, right-click to finish. Footpath or cart track, with plants along the edge
translation: 小路——点击设点绘制线路，右键完成。可绘制步道或车辙路，路边带植被

source: Painting over a field changes its crop
translation: 在农田上涂画可更换作物

source: Paint over plants to remove them - all vegetation types at once
translation: 涂画植被可将其清除，一次清除所有植被类型

source: Amount and Size apply to what you paint now. Replace: 0 % adds to what grows there, 100 % replaces it. Shift erases.
translation: 数量和大小影响当前绘制。替换：0 % 在现有植被上添加，100 % 完全替换。Shift 擦除。

source: Click a vegetation type and paint it onto the ground
translation: 点击植被类型，然后在地面上涂画

source: Click a %s to select it. Shift adds more, drag for a box, Alt+click selects a whole row.
translation: 点击一个%s选中它。Shift 可多选，拖动可框选，Alt+点击可选整排。

source: Drag an arrow to move, the yellow one extrudes. Hold Shift for millimetres. Ctrl+click an edge to add a point.
translation: 拖动箭头移动，黄色箭头用于挤出。按住 Shift 按毫米精调。Ctrl+点击边可添加顶点。

source: Click a value, then use the stick
translation: 点击数值，再用摇杆调整

source: Click a value to type a number
translation: 点击数值即可输入数字

source: 1. = top. Hold a button and drag it onto another to swap.
translation: 1 表示最上层。按住按钮拖到另一个按钮上即可交换。

source: Selected: %s, %.0f cm. Drag its arrows up or down - the neighbour gives way; the top arrow sets the height.
translation: 已选择：%s，%.0f 厘米。上下拖动箭头，相邻部分会让位；顶部箭头调整高度。

source: Click a door, drawer or shelf in 3D to resize it with arrows.
translation: 在三维视图中点击柜门、抽屉或搁板，即可用箭头调整尺寸。

source: Front style applies to all tall units, handles to this one
translation: 门板样式应用于所有高柜，把手仅应用于当前高柜

source: Select one to edit its color
Shift-click: more modules · Width: neighbours give way · Del deletes the run
translation: Shift+点击：多选模块 · 宽度：相邻模块让位 · Del 删除整排

source: Grows only where there is house wall behind it - around windows and up the gable.
translation: 仅在后方有房屋墙体的地方生长，绕过窗户并攀上山墙。

source: Wall - click corners, snaps like the 2D plan
translation: 墙壁——点击角点，吸附方式与二维平面图相同

source: Overlay on: storey %d lies as a transparency over the plan. Click to hide it
translation: 叠加已开启：第 %d 层以半透明方式显示在平面图上。点击隐藏

source: Overlay: show storey %d as a transparency over the plan
translation: 叠加显示：将第 %d 层半透明显示在平面图上

source: Storey %d: this is the one you are editing
translation: 第 %d 层：正在编辑此层

source: Add a storey on top: it starts with a copy of the top floor walls
translation: 在顶部添加一层：初始墙体将复制顶层的墙体

source: Add a basement below: it starts with a copy of the lowest floor walls
translation: 在底部添加地下室：初始墙体将复制最底层的墙体

source: Show the house only up to one storey: the ceiling and everything above it is hidden, so you can furnish that floor from above.
translation: 仅显示房屋至指定楼层：隐藏该层天花板及其上方全部内容，便于从上方布置本层家具。

source: Show storey %d without the ceiling and floors above
translation: 显示第 %d 层，隐藏其天花板及上方楼层

source: Lighting and sky of the scene
How the camera moves, and which key does what
translation: 相机移动方式与按键功能

source: Fly where you look — the usual 3D movement
translation: 朝视线方向飞行 — 常规三维移动方式

source: W and S keep the height, no matter where the camera looks
translation: 按 W 和 S 保持高度移动，不受相机朝向影响

source: Holding the right mouse button turns around what you look at; the point moves with you
translation: 按住鼠标右键，围绕注视点旋转；该点会随你移动

source: You are viewing someone else's design
translation: 你正在查看其他玩家的设计

source: Saved only to your Workshop saves — the original stays untouched
translation: 仅保存到你的工坊存档中 — 原作品保持不变

source: Move everything you built into another environment
translation: 将你建造的所有内容移至另一个环境
